title: Grading Scale Impact on LLM-as-a-Judge: Human-LLM Alignment Is Highest on 0-5 Grading Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing absolute agreement metrics (Intraclass Correlation Coefficients and normalized Mean Absolute Error) between LLM judgments and human ratings, stratified by the self-reported gender of the human annotators to identify systematic subgroup differences in human-LLM alignment.
